english.fix: The eighty-ri road from the Gyeongju garrison to Ulsan, seat of the provincial military commander, was a march of death: with large swords around their necks, they walked over stones, gravel, and thorns, reaching the Ulsan parade ground in two days, and there on September 14, 1868, the 28th day of the seventh lunar month, they were beheaded.
